message:
I had a little moment of triumph the other night during a surprise power outage. With the wind howling outside, I could hear the faint sounds of frustration from my neighbors fumbling around in the dark. But me? I had my trusty flashlight and a few fully charged power banks ready to roll. 

I even found a cozy spot in my living room, lit up by my favorite lantern, and settled in for some reading while enjoying a snack from my stocked pantry. It felt pretty great to finally be the prepared one instead of scrambling at the last minute. 

How about you? What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a blackout? 🌟
